name: GitButler
tagline: Git client backed by Tauri, Rust and Svelte.
hook: A short root guide covering instruction precedence, repository structure, working style, and links to local instructions.
summary: GitButler's 42-line root file contains a repository map, a short working-style list, and two links to local instruction files.

techniques.title: A numbered precedence order
techniques.body: Three instruction sources are ranked in the opening lines: explicit human instructions, then the nearest nested AGENTS.md, then this file. The conflict case is answered before any rule is given.
techniques.quote:
Apply all relevant instruction files. If instructions conflict, resolve them in
this order:

1. Explicit human instructions
2. Nearest nested `AGENTS.md`
3. This file

techniques.title: Questions treated as read-only
techniques.body: A question about the codebase does not imply permission to change it. The default is stated in one line at the top of the working style section.
techniques.quote: Treat questions about the codebase as read-only unless the user asks for changes.

techniques.title: Reproduce before adding machinery
techniques.body: Reproduce a behavior bug with a failing test, then inspect existing loops and classifications for the right home. The tests determine how much implementation the fix needs.
techniques.quote: let the tests, not the diagnosis, set how much implementation the fix needs

techniques.title: Propose a new mechanism before building it
techniques.body: A fix requiring a new module, a new public API, or a parallel walk where one already exists is to be proposed in shape before implementation.

techniques.title: A cross-surface completion check
techniques.body: Before shared behavior is called done, each applicable surface is checked and either updated or explicitly determined to be unaffected. Six surfaces and docs are named.
techniques.quote:
Before declaring shared behavior done, check each applicable surface and contract
  (desktop, web, Lite, CLI/TUI, N-API, SDK, and docs) and update it or explicitly
  determine that it is unaffected.

steal: If you have nested instruction files, state the precedence order in the first paragraph.
State that a question is a question. Agents otherwise read "why does this happen" as "fix this".
List the surfaces that shared behavior has to reach, and require each to be checked or ruled out by name.
